name: The Only Cure is More Green Glow

chain: The Only Cure is More Green Glow

summary: In Kharanos, Ozzie Togglevolt seeks a cure for the leper gnomes. He needs a pure sample of fallout from deep inside Gnomeregan.

sections.title: A Pure Sample
sections.body: Ozzie Togglevolt's first tests outside Gnomeregan gave him no answers. The troggs in Dun Morogh carried too little residue, and what they bore was impure. Now, from his lab in Kharanos, Ozzie seeks a fresh, concentrated sample from deep inside the city. He hopes it will help him find a remedy for the leper gnomes.

sections.title: Straight from the Tap
sections.body: You need to gather potent fallout from inside Gnomeregan. Irradiated horrors, lurkers, and slimes fill the lower depths around the Hall of Gears and Clean Zone. Their unstable ooze must be carried in a heavy leaden phial, and the work is dangerous. The fallout quickly loses its potency, so you need to get it to Ozzie's lab in Kharanos in time.

faq.q: Why does Ozzie need radioactive fallout?
faq.answer: Ozzie Togglevolt seeks a cure for the leper gnomes, whose minds and bodies were ruined by the fallout released during Gnomeregan's fall. He believes a pure sample of the poison may help reverse its effects.

faq.q: Where does the player find the fallout?
aliases: where is high potency radioactive fallout
faq.answer: You can gather fallout from living irradiated horrors, lurkers, and slimes in Gnomeregan's depths, especially around the Hall of Gears and past the Clean Zone.

faq.q: Why were the surface trogg samples rejected?
faq.answer: Troggs outside Gnomeregan carried too little contamination, and their samples were impure. They could not give Ozzie reliable material for his research into a cure.

faq.q: Why is the fallout on a time limit?
faq.answer: The fallout is unstable and quickly loses potency, even in a leaden phial. It must reach Ozzie's lab in Kharanos before it breaks down.

faq.q: Who are the leper gnomes Ozzie hopes to help?
faq.answer: Leper gnomes were citizens of Gnomeregan, trapped inside when the radiation valves opened to fight the troggs. They survived, but became sickened and deranged, hostile to their former kin.
Ozzie Togglevolt is a gnome researcher based in Kharanos in Dun Morogh. He asks you to gather fallout as he works to remedy the harm caused by Gnomeregan's catastrophe.

angles.text: As a gnome, you carry the grief of your lost home. Helping Ozzie learn whether the mutations can be undone offers hope of redeeming your fallen kin.
As an engineer, you know radiation calls for sturdy lead shielding and precise instruments. Gnomeregan shows the cost of engineering failure.
As an Alliance member, you can help stabilize Dun Morogh and reclaim Gnomeregan by learning how to face the lethal hazards threatening Ironforge's doorstep.
